en.title: Steven Yeun and Paul Bettany Star in Netflix's Sinister New Thriller 'Pagans'
en.summary: Filming has officially begun on Joshua Zetumer's unsettling new Netflix series, 'Pagans,' bringing together a stellar cast led by Steven Yeun and Paul Bettany. The thriller promises a dark exploration of family dynamics that delve into the unspoken fears of parenthood.
en.body:
The eerie atmosphere of New York City is currently serving as the backdrop for **Netflix**'s latest thriller, **'Pagans'**, as filming gets underway. Spearheaded by showrunner **Joshua Zetumer**, known for his work on FX's 'Say Nothing,' the series is poised to delve into the darker corners of familial relationships. The compelling synopsis hints at a supernatural drama that uses genre conventions to unearth "all the dark thoughts that parents have, the kind of thoughts mom and dad are never supposed to talk about."

The narrative centers on a widowed father, played by **Steven Yeun** (known for 'The Walking Dead' and 'Beef'), who becomes the sole caretaker of his two children. While his son is described as typical, his daughter, Alice, is anything but. What begins as a strained father-daughter dynamic quickly escalates into something far more sinister, promising a blend of emotional depth, horror, and unexpected humor.

## Cast and Creative Forces Behind 'Pagans'

The ensemble cast is a major draw for this project. **Steven Yeun** takes on the role of Gus, the father navigating this increasingly complex situation. **Marin Ireland** steps into the role of Alice, the troubled teenage daughter whose behavior pushes boundaries. **Intae Kim** will portray Casey, Gus's younger brother, who arrives to offer support when the family needs it most. Other confirmed cast members include **Sabine Grace**, who is set for a breakout role as Alice, and **Paul Bettany** ('WandaVision'), whose role is currently undisclosed but adds significant star power to the production.

Behind the camera, **Joshua Zetumer** serves not only as showrunner but also as a co-writer, alongside a talented team including **Clare Barron**, **Eboni Booth**, **Joe Murtagh**, **Olivia Dufault**, and producer **Victor LaValle**. The series is being produced by **Goddard Textiles**, with **Drew Goddard** ('Project Hail Mary') and **Sarah Esberg** among the executive producers. **Steven Yeun** himself is also an executive producer, signaling his deep investment in the project through his company, Celadon Pictures, alongside **Christina Oh**.

## Why This Matters to Fans

For fans of character-driven thrillers and supernatural dramas, **'Pagans'** represents a significant new offering from **Netflix**. The combination of **Zetumer**'s knack for complex narratives, **Goddard**'s proven track record in genre storytelling, and a cast featuring acclaimed actors like **Yeun** and **Bettany** sets high expectations. The series' focus on the unsettling, unspoken aspects of parenting and family trauma is a theme that resonates deeply, offering fertile ground for intense performances and gripping storytelling. Viewers will be eager to see how the show balances its horror elements with its emotional core, and whether it can deliver the kind of binge-worthy experience that keeps audiences hooked.

## What's Next

With filming now in progress, details regarding a release date for **'Pagans'** have not yet been announced. Fans should anticipate further casting announcements and glimpses into the production as it unfolds throughout the coming months.

content_raw: Picture (L to R): Paul Bettany and Steven Yeun Filming is underway in New York on Joshua Zetumer’s thriller series, Pagans. The cast includes Sabine Grace, Steven Yeun, Marin Ireland, Logan Kim, Intae Kim, and Paul Bettany. The series follows a widowed father and his deeply troubled, boundary-pushing teenage daughter, Alice. Here is everything we know so far about the plot, cast, and production of Netflix’s Pagans . Pagans is an upcoming Netflix Original series created by showrunner Joshua Zetumer (Say Nothing) . The series is co-written by Zetumer, who is joined by Clare Barron, Eboni Booth, Joe Murtagh, Olivia Dufault, and producer Victor LaValle.  Picture: Joshua Zetumer at the screening for FX’s ‘Say the Nothing’ – Ben Hider/PictureGroup Goddard Textiles is producing the series, with founder Drew Goddard (Project Hail Mary) and Sarah Esberg serving as executive producers, joined by Andrea Massaro as co-executive producer. The series is being developed through Netflix’s studio group headed by Nne Ebong. What is the plot of Pagans ? The synopsis has been sourced from Production Weekly:  “The supernatural drama, follows a man who becomes the sole caretaker of his two children after the tragic loss of his wife. While his son is typical, his daughter, Alice, is anything but. What starts as a strained father-daughter relationship soon evolves into something far more sinister. Equal parts emotional, horrifying and humorous, Pagans uses genre to unearth all the dark thoughts that parents have, the kind of thoughts mom and dad are never supposed to talk about.” Who are the cast members of Pagans ? Sabine Grace plays Alice, who is primed for a breakout role after previous appearances in two shorts and a guest spot on Yo Gabba Gabbaland . She is joined by Steven Yeun , a veteran of multiple Netflix Originals like Beef and Animals , alongside Logan Kim , who lands his first Netflix project in a fun twist of fate as the onscreen son of his co-star’s former The Walking Dead character. Rounding out the ensemble are Marin Ireland , bringing experience from Netflix’s The Umbrella Academy and The Irishman , and Intae Kim , who steps into his debut Netflix series following appearances in prestige dramas like Succession and Severance . Picture: Paul Bettany plays Vision in the MCU On November 5th, it was announced that Paul Bettany had joined the cast as Mag.
